name: B-1/B-2 Visitor Visa and Visa Waiver Program (ESTA)

requirements.blocker_text: This requires showing you'll leave the US at the end of your visit.
This requires holding a passport from a Visa Waiver Program participating country and obtaining ESTA authorization before travel.

evidence_required.document: ESTA authorization (VWP group) or MRV fee payment and DS-160 (B-1/B-2 group)

outcome.duration_length: B-1/B-2 typically valid up to 10 years, admission usually up to 6 months per visit; ESTA valid 2 years, admission up to 90 days per visit

sources.title: Visitor Visa - US Department of State
ESTA - US Customs and Border Protection

notes: MRV fee $185 (B-1/B-2 DS-160). ESTA fee $40, confirmed to include a not-less-than-$13 increase effective 1 Oct 2025, indexed to inflation from FY2026. ENACTED BUT NOT OPERATIONAL, flagged consistently with how this dataset treats similar cases: a $250 minimum Visa Integrity Fee was created by the One Big Beautiful Bill Act (Public Law 119-21, 4 July 2025) for most nonimmigrant visa issuances (exempt: ESTA/VWP travelers, Canadians, change-of-status applicants), indexed to CPI from FY2026 — but DHS/State had not finalized the collection mechanism as of this verification, and it was NOT yet being collected. This is genuinely the same 'enacted-not-operational' pattern seen on Portugal's skilled job-seeker visa and Japan's Ikusei Shuro program, the third instance of this case type across the full research pass — not encoded as an active fee requirement here since it isn't yet operative.
